subject: Post-demo: procurement checklist, vendor packet, and marketplace preference
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightbridge.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: BrightBridge Procurement <procurement@brightbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — procurement checklist request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency profiles and the model routing examples. Procurement asked me to pull together the next steps so we can kick off vendor setup. A few asks from finance/procurement: 

- Vendor packet (W-9 / tax forms)
- Banking details (where to send POs / ACH info)
- Contract template or MSA and estimated first invoice
- Clarify buying path: will we go via PO on file, corporate card, or the cloud marketplace?

We are aiming for a vendor activation by 4/5 if possible. Can you send the intake packet and a short checklist we can pass to procurement? Also, any notes on typical lead time for a PO vs card setup would help.

Thanks — happy to loop in procurement directly if helpful.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager | BrightBridge Health
S: +1 415-555-0199

--
This message may contain confidential information.

From: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — procurement checklist request

Hi Samantha — great to hear the demo landed well. Thanks for listing procurement's asks; I pulled together the items below and attached the vendor packet and W-9. Quick checklist and notes: 

1) Vendor packet (attached) — contains completed vendor intake form, redwood W-9, standard MSA, and banking routing instructions stub. Please have procurement fill in the "BrightBridge contact" fields and return the vendor intake PDF.

2) Banking details — we can accept ACH or wire. For PO processing, our accounting team requires a signed vendor packet + PO issued to "Redwood Inference, Inc."

3) Contract / MSA — attached standard MSA. Minor commercial redlines are typically handled within 3 business days; any security questionnaire items may add time.

4) Buying path guidance: 
   - PO path: typical procurement internal lead time 7–14 business days (depends on your internal PO approvals).
   - Card path: faster for pilot purchases under $10k — card or virtual card can clear in 1–3 business days.
   - Marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure): adds ~1–2 weeks for registration with the marketplace vendor portal but simplifies invoicing if you'd prefer that flow.

Next steps I propose: 
- I attach the vendor packet (BrightBridge-vendor-packet.pdf) and W-9 for your finance team to review.
- If procurement would like, I can schedule a 30-minute intake call next week with our commercial ops (Marissa) to walk the packet and answer PO/card questions.

I've CC'd Marissa (commercial operations) and Dev (billing ops) to handle the paperwork and banking follow-ups. 

If timeline goal is 4/5, suggest procurement return the completed intake form and indicate preferred buying path by 3/29 so we can prioritize activation.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 628-555-0104

Attachments: BrightBridge-vendor-packet.pdf (vendor intake form, MSA, W-9 stub), redwood_vendor_portal_instructions.pdf

From: BrightBridge Procurement <procurement@brightbridge.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — procurement checklist request

Hi Mina / Samantha,

Thanks — we reviewed the packet. A couple of clarifying questions from procurement: 

- The vendor intake PDF has a blank for "bank account number" — is that something you populate or should we leave blank and provide after PO is issued?
- For marketplace option: does Redwood bill through the marketplace invoice (we'd prefer consolidated monthly invoicing) or is there still a separate Redwood invoice outside of the marketplace?

Timeline: we can turn around vendor setup in ~10 business days once we receive a completed intake form + W-9. PO approvals add another ~5 business days after the intake is processed. If we go via card, we can do an initial pilot payment immediately.

Also copying our AP inbox for routing questions.

Regards,

Hi Brenda / Samantha — Marissa here from Commercial Ops. Quick answers to your questions and a couple of asks so we can move forward: 

- Bank account number: we never include full account numbers in initial PDF responses. Once the vendor packet is returned signed, our finance team will send secure banking instructions (ACH routing + account) via our payment portal. If you prefer, we can also accept a vendor-secured portal upload.

- Marketplace billing: Redwood supports marketplace billing for AWS/Azure/GCP. If you register via the marketplace, BrightBridge will receive consolidated marketplace invoices; Redwood's invoices will be represented inside the marketplace billing flow (no separate monthly invoice required from Redwood). Note: register time varies by marketplace (7–14 days typical).

Action items from our side: 
1) Mina — I will drop a signed vendor packet (signed by Redwood) to the DocuSign link and copy procurement once complete.
2) Dev — please prepare the secure banking instruction email to send to procurement once we have the signed intake.
3) Samantha / Brenda — please return the completed vendor intake form by Monday 3/29 and indicate preferred buying path (PO / card / marketplace). If you'd like the intake call, Mina / I are available Wed/Thu next week.

Attachments: W9_BrightBridge.pdf (copy of W-9 as requested)

Thanks — we'll prioritize to hit the 4/5 activation target if you can return the form on the timeline above.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
